subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Cringe Comedy Phenomenon
description: A 60-second lesson on The Cringe Comedy Phenomenon.

hook.text: Watching Michael Scott in The Office is painful. You laugh, but you also want to crawl under the couch.

buildup.text: Cringe comedy gets its power from secondhand embarrassment. The audience suffers alongside the characters.

discovery.text: Ricky Gervais perfected the format with The Office UK. Larry David made it an art form with Curb Your Enthusiasm.

climax.text: The format works because it's honest. Real life is full of awkward moments we pretend don't happen.

punchline.text: The funniest comedy is the kind that hurts to watch.
